justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/Evaluator.java, where IsLastOfType is a final nested class with only a constructor and toString(), and it inherits all matching behavior from IsNthLastOfType. That gives it no independent responsibilities, no method bloat, and no signs of low cohesion or a need to split it further. Also checked src/test/java/org/jsoup/select/EvaluatorTest.java, where it is only exercised for basic toString behavior.
